title: Cool Two-Bedroom Cottage in E Nashville
description:
Cozy, renovated home with two plush, new beds. Two min from Ellington Pkwy for quick access to East Nashville 5-Points, Downtown, or Opryland area. Private parking and full amenities. Awesome long-term rental. Great quiet neighborhood, all needs within 1 mile. Quick and easy access to downtown, and always an Uber within minutes.  Can perfectly host two couples, a small group, or a family.
Uber to downtown Broadway area is 10 minutes. 7 minutes to Opry Area.

The space
The house is a cozy cottage in a quiet neighborhood with a front yard, small front porch, and designated parking off the driveway.  The property is a duplex, but there is no shared access (or parking) of any kind, though one building, the units are completely separated.  Unless my amazing tenant is pulling in and out of the driveway or putting out the trash bins, you likely won't even know they're there.
